about: Surani Steel Tubes Limited, incorporated in 2012 and listed on NSE Emerge, manufactures and trades ERW mild-steel pipes/tubes from Dahegam, Gujarat, including round pipes and square/rectangular hollow sections used in infrastructure, engineering, agriculture, construction, energy, water, gas and related applications.
